parts.name: ScrollArea
parts.description: A native scroll viewport with custom overlay rails. Root ref targets the outer container; viewportProps.ref targets the actual scrolling element. Ordinary viewport gestures and keyboard scrolling remain native.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the keyboard-focusable native viewport.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Rail palette: contrast by default; normal uses a transparent track and border-colored thumb; hidden removes rails while keeping native scrolling and keyboard access.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axes that are scrollable and receive custom rails.

props.name: overscrollBehavior
props.description: Native chaining on enabled axes. Disabled axes stay auto. contain/none isolate the enabled axis; viewportProps.style can override it.

props.name: type
props.description: Rail visibility: auto for overflow, always, hover, or scroll.

props.name: scrollHideDelay
props.description: Radix hide delay in milliseconds for hover/scroll visibility modes.

props.name: dir
props.description: Text and keyboard direction: ltr or rtl.

props.name: viewportProps
props.description: Props/ref/styles for the actual viewport. Its onWheelCapture can cancel Shift compensation over content; rails are outside this element.

props.name: onWheelCapture
props.description: Capture wheel input over the viewport and rails. Prevent default here to cancel built-in Shift/rail compensation before it runs.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
